# Huggy

Huggy is an AI app builder for creating, previewing, iterating and publishing production-ready web apps.

## Important pages
- Home: https://huggy.fun/
- Pricing: https://huggy.fun/pricing.html
- Features: https://huggy.fun/features.html
- Documentation: https://huggy.fun/documentation.html
- Use cases: https://huggy.fun/use-cases/
- Guides: https://huggy.fun/guides/
- SEO audit: https://huggy.fun/tools/seo-audit/
- Showcase: https://huggy.fun/built-with-huggy/

## Product facts
- Huggy supports prompt-to-app generation, project preview, database visibility, publishing workflows and model selection.
- Huggy is designed for founders, agencies, product teams and non-technical builders.
- Private app routes such as auth, dashboard and builder are not intended for indexing.
